description.en: The application name of the stream.

descriptions.zh:
本接口适用于触发拉流，调用本接口查询播流域名下触发拉流配置信息。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation supports retrieving only the configurations of triggered stream pulling.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per minute per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-lazy-pull-stream-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
